See Studomate in action

Write the logic

GRAFCET and Ladder in the same project, sharing the same variables.

GRAFCET

Draw steps, transitions and branches, then follow the GRAFCET as it runs: active steps, true conditions, running actions.

Ladder

Build rungs with contacts, coils, timers and counters, and watch power flow through them during simulation.

Drive the machine

Connect your program to an HMI, a 3D scene or a real Arduino board.

HMI

Build animated supervision pages (lights, buttons, tanks, moving objects) wired to the same variables as your programs.

3D scenes

Connect your program to a virtual 3D plant (conveyors, cylinders, sensors) and watch the machine respond in real time.

Arduino

Load your program onto a real Arduino Uno R3 board, or use its inputs and outputs during simulation, straight from Chrome or Edge.

Why Studomate?

Studomate exists to cut the friction of learning automation down to almost nothing.

Students (technical colleges, engineering schools, universities)
Teachers and trainers in automation / electrical engineering
Professionals retraining or brushing up

Zero friction

No install, no licence, no PLC or I/O cards to set up. You focus on the logic, not the tool.

All-in-one

GRAFCET, Ladder and animated HMIs in the same environment, with variables shared across all three. No free tool combines the three.

Short correction loop

Errors are flagged while you edit, not only when you start the simulation. A fast, visual right to make mistakes.

Real-time simulation

Step-by-step or continuous execution, with live visualisation of states, transitions and variables.

Built-in manual

Complete help available straight from the app.

Accounts & cloud (optional)

Projects stored locally or in the cloud, with link sharing.

Examples to get you started

Open a pre-configured project and explore it at your own pace.

Traffic light crossroads

12 boolean outputs (red/amber/green × 4 lights: NS1, NS2, EO1, EO2) + an HMI with the crossroads. Plant simulated by the 3D scene. To be programmed.

Open in the app

Barrier car park

Two barriers (entry and exit) and a space counter: sensors for a waiting car, a photocell under the barrier, a "full" lamp and a counter in the 3D scene, where the Arrival and Departure buttons bring cars. To be programmed.

Learn industrial automation with Studomate

Guided modules to master GRAFCET, then Ladder, with exercises you can simulate in the app.

  • Basics

    Module A0: Before you start

    Automation, variables, basic logic and the scan cycle.

  • GRAFCET

    Module A1: GRAFCET basics

    Steps, transitions, actions, OR and AND branches.

  • Ladder

    Module A2: Ladder, logic and memory

    Contacts, coils, latching, set/reset coils and edges.

  • Ladder

    Module A3: Ladder, time and calculation

    Timers, counters, calculations and subroutines.

  • GRAFCET → Ladder

    Module A4: From GRAFCET to Ladder (part 1)

    Implement a GRAFCET in Ladder: one network per transition, two programs, actions, time and faults.

  • GRAFCET → Ladder (continued)

    Module A5: From GRAFCET to Ladder (part 2)

    OR and AND divergences, stopping a sequence, limits of one network per transition and the three-block method.

Your projects are yours

No lock-in

Your projects are files you export and keep. The schema is versioned: a project exported today will still open after the tool is updated.

You depend on no one

The code is free under the AGPL v3 licence: if the project stops, it can be forked or self-hosted.

Built for privacy

No email required, no personal data stored, no tracking cookies. Authentication uses a nickname, and usage statistics are anonymous.

The source code is public: read it, report an issue or contribute.
